propositions: structured_run.py exceeds the 500-LOC target at 796 LOC due to accreting three distinct responsibilities: run mechanism, cache-effectiveness diagnostics, and failure interpretation.

Cache-effectiveness diagnostics cluster (warn_if_cache_ineffective, cache_write_never_read, warn_if_cache_write_never_read, estimate_marked_prefix_tokens, _warn_if_zeroed_usage) must be extracted to cache_diagnostics.py.
Failure-interpretation cluster (FailureContext, interpret_failure, _write_parse_failure_artifact) must be extracted to run_failure.py.
All public import paths must be preserved via re-exports from structured_run.py so external importers and tests remain untouched.
After split, structured_run.py must be ≤500 LOC; both new modules must be ≥100 LOC; all linting, type-checking, and module-size gates must pass.
